The '''Skylark''' was one of the [[skyfighter]] classes in use by the [[Exocron Airfleet]]. The fighter was capable of speeds up to two hundred [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] per hour; its armament consisted of one [[projectile cannon]] and two [[percussion cannon]]s.
